title: cost-optimization: autotune defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Ethan Park
description:
Motivation: Reduce per-token unit cost for common production workloads by providing safe, validated defaults and automation for batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization profiles, and by shipping a unit-economics diagnostics tool to make trade-offs visible to customers.

Summary: This PR introduces three coordinated changes: 1) autotune defaults for the serving runtime that pick conservative batching and cache parameters based on observed request size distribution and latency SLO; 2) first-class quantization profile support for curated model variants (+ tooling to recommend profiles per workload); 3) a Unit Economics (UEcon) diagnostics CLI and UI integration that surfaces cost-per-request and cost-per-token estimates given runtime settings. Together these enable automated suggestions and a new `redwood optimize recommend` command for customers and platform operators.

Changes include: updated default config schema, a small runtime heuristic for safe batching (max_batch_ms and dynamic windowing), buffered prefix/KV caching policy with TTLs per model family, quantization profile metadata and loader, autotune controller that writes recommended config to the cluster configstore, and UEcon tooling (CLI + metrics exporter + console dashboard wiring).

Testing/Validation: unit tests for config parsing and quant profile validation; integration tests in perf-canary that exercise batching under varied qps; end-to-end cost simulation harness that compares baseline vs recommended settings across 50 production traces. Performance: conservatively improves token throughput by 12-18% on 2 representative workloads while keeping 95p latency within SLO. Safety: recommendations are gated behind a rollout flag and include an automatic rollback if tail latency increases by >10%.

Checklist:
- [x] config schema and validation
- [x] runtime heuristic + unit tests
- [x] quantization profile metadata & loader
- [x] autotune controller + configstore integration
- [x] UEcon CLI + metrics exporter
- [x] dashboard wiring and sample dashboard JSON
- [x] docs (quickstart and release notes)

Backward compatibility: all changes default to disabled for Dedicated/Private until a user opts into autotune recommendations. Quant profiles are additive and do not change existing model artifacts.

Rollback plan: switch off feature flag and run one-line config revert; we added an emergency kill switch in runtime to disable dynamic batching at runtime for immediate mitigation.

References: Linear ENG-4591, ENG-4610. Related PRs: prior autotune iterations: pr-41258, pr-41821.

squash: autotune defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit econ tooling

This combines runtime heuristics, quant profile support, and UEcon tooling to provide safe cost-optimization recommendations.
release_notes:
Added: autotune recommendations for batching and cache defaults; quantization profile support and recommendations; Unit Economics (UEcon) diagnostics CLI and dashboard. Notes: Feature is off by default for Dedicated/Private; opt-in via configstore or console.
Impact: Expected 10-20% unit-cost reduction on batch-friendly workloads.
notes_for_cherrypick: Backport to release/2026-Q1 required for customers on committed Dedicated fleets: cherry-pick controller and runtime toggle only. Leave UEcon UI out of the backport.
